ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels in the central and leading regions to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels on the distal lobe surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity region forms a large contiguous 'Y' shape from the peduncle junction. Flanked by high-intensity white regions on the outer 40% of each lobe. Right lobe features localized dark circular spots (mottling) within the high-intensity zone.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central notch with an approximate 40-50 degree interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern across the trailing edge boundary; amplitude increases toward the lateral tips where jagged clusters are prominent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from the notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a convex sweep at the distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast clusters of bumps and dark spots located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, indicative of sessile organism colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two parallel, diagonal low-intensity linear streaks on the left lobe; one prominent diagonal streak on the upper right lobe passing through the white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable ragged notch/irregularity on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the tip, distinct from natural serration.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical low-intensity band on the right lobe creating a sharp geometric boundary between the white distal area and the black central field.
